text: Don't touch the green one. Don't touch any of them, actually. Hands where I can see them.
You've the look of somebody who goes into the gates. You'll want things that close holes in you faster than they open. That's my trade.

options.text: What's in the vials on your chest?

text: {player}. Still breathing. My potions or your luck?
Mending draughts, the red ones. Dark-sight for the Crypt, gill-water for the Cellar, a slowfall for anyone fool enough to climb Gallows Hill in the wind.
Strength, if you can pay for it. It tastes of iron and burns going down. That's how you know it's working.
Spider eyes. Glowstone. Wart, if anyone still goes down to the Nether.
And what the gates leave. Rot-mycelium, corpse wax, cork that's been soaking in something for a hundred years. Good bases, all of them. Better in my pot than on your boots.
Green: it stops the heart for a breath, then starts it again harder. Red: it does the opposite. The violet one... the violet one's mine.
I tried one of each on a man from the Crypt once, the thing that came out of it, I mean. The green worked. Twice.
Drink before, not during. The dead don't wait while you uncork.
And if something in there spits on you and it fizzes, come straight to me. Don't go to the chapel. Prayer's slower.
